criteria.text: Preserve existing Rhythm mark/green palette, system native operational type, existing brand font only where already used. Use 4pt spacing, ≥44x44 touch targets, AA-target semantic colors, Dynamic Type resilient content-sized layouts. No new dependency/framework/state store/list migration.

Rename visible Agents tab/surface to Chats while retaining route IDs. Chats has obvious New chat, visible search/current filters/Clear filters, title+recency+project/state rows, correct empty vs filtered-empty vs refresh-failed-with-data feedback. Do not fetch previews/histories.

Conversation presentation has compact hierarchy, transcript gets actual currentSessionId when the owned component interface permits but DO NOT edit ChatView caller; if caller wiring is needed record integration requirement. Preserve reading anchor/loading earlier/current content on errors; no forced scroll while reading older messages.

Composer stable positions attachment/text/send and separately named dictation/stop controls; explicit labels/roles/busy/disabled meaning; intrinsic multiline native sizing; failed/unknown send UI preserves content according to callbacks. Do not put draft/domain logic in component.
Add prop-driven auth/sign-in screen showing restoring/signed-out/signing-in/cancel/error/retry states, existing mark and Google action; no OAuth/storage/fetch logic. Manager wires root shell later.

Settings use clearer grouped Account, Mac connection, Notifications, Voice/responses, Advanced presentation where owned; distinguish Sign out/Forget/Revoke; adjust sliders with accessible actions or existing labeled +/- controls; prevent fixed sheet clipping.

NativeSelect and owned portals expose labels/selected state/modal semantics, focus/escape/restoration to extent supported by existing primitives. Question choices expose checked semantics. Reduce Motion branch for decorative voice animation if file owned; otherwise record integration.
criteria.reason: NativeSelect modal/checked semantics pass component tests; native focus restoration, question-choice semantics, and Reduce Motion behavior remain final accessibility acceptance.

criteria.text: Secondary owned shared state/list surfaces retain data on refresh failure, show useful loading/empty/error/offline/retry, and gate mutation controls by provided authority/pending state without inventing backend logic.

UI-driven performance: avoid fresh extraData/row closures/whole-list work where a small memoization or existing FlashList use demonstrably helps; baseline/remeasure identical component scenarios if feasible. No claimed percentage without 10 comparable runs. Do not add previews.

Tests cover composer labels/stable controls/multiline; chat list filters/empty/refresh; dynamic type/source contracts; auth screen states; select semantics. Preserve old intrinsic composer behavior, deliberately update brittle source assertions only with behavioral equivalent.

Real hosted Google sign-in, refreshed native-artifact installation, and service-unavailable recovery presentation passed; VoiceOver, contrast, keyboard, actual environment, and live chats remain not_tested and mandatory manager gates.
